source.attribution: NASA/WMAP Science Team, LAMBDA/HEASARC; native public scientific products; retain source citations and processing metadata.
source.rights_scope: No blanket license is inferred for third-party papers. Public map-source bytes are linked; this release publishes numerical derivatives and provenance.

source_processing.processing: Pixel average to RING Nside16; map2alm iter3 lmax32; remove l0,l1; additional 5 degree Gaussian beam; alm2map.
source_processing.mask: Native KQ85 averaged to Nside16; keep fraction >=0.8 and |Galactic latitude|>=20 degrees.
source_processing.effective_resolution: Input beams differ; all get the same additional 5-degree smoothing. Not an exact common-beam deconvolution.
source_processing.scale_scope: Broad 12/18/24 degree Gaussian widths and radial annuli. Not a degree-scale Hawking-point reproduction.

model.pooling: 4 -> 2 -> 1 qubits; retain 0,2 then 0; discarded outcomes not postselected

model_training.source: Independent random-phase ILC surrogates and declared injected Gaussian profiles; original observed phases not scored during selection.
model_training.scope: Classically simulated four-qubit hierarchical channel with actually trained gates and readout; not quantum hardware or the full Mora-3 model.

null: Independent random phases at m>0 and random signs at m=0 conditional on each processed observed alm magnitude; l=0,1 removed. All reference/training/calibration/validation seeds are distinct.
null_limitations: Exact randomization rank requires invariance under the stated phase group. Real anisotropic noise, foreground cleaning, mask effects and harmonic estimation are not fully modeled. Rejection tests this surrogate null and template family, not CCC uniquely.
shared_observations: ILC,V,W are derived from the same WMAP observations and same sky. Bonferroni does not assume independence; products are sensitivity comparisons, not independent discoveries.
heldout_definition: Training/validation/calibration null realizations are disjoint; the real sky is scored only after weights and normalization freeze.
